variant_perception_summary: Sell-side consensus and Tesla's own decade-long trading multiple already price a continuation of the autonomy/robotics optionality premium (mean target $409.81, +28.2% implied upside, FY2027-28 EPS consensus assuming 69-89% YoY growth with no disclosed segment economics). Three independently-built valuation methods (peer comps, sum-of-the-parts, DCF) converge near $32-41/share against a $319.69 price. The moat is not merely unproven but confirmed eroding (ROIC down every year for 3 years, 210-885bps below cost of capital), and an unresolved federal securities-fraud class action names the CEO personally on the exact autonomy claims the premium depends on, compounded by a board-enacted entrenchment sequence narrowing the legal tool that could hold him accountable. The catalyst that would force repricing is undated, which is why this is expressed as a small, defined-risk position rather than full conviction.
what_everyone_knows: Tesla trades at an 800-2,300% premium to named auto peers across every headline multiple; bulls call it an AI/robotics platform, not a car company; sell-side consensus is itself bullish (Outperform, mean target $409.81, 39-40 analysts).
what_is_priced_in: Consensus EPS estimates already assume 69% (FY2027) and 89% (FY2028) YoY growth acceleration; the price implies a 68.9% seven-year free-cash-flow CAGR, or capturing 75-100%+ of the entire global automotive industry by FY2032, with no historical precedent for any automaker.
what_market_may_be_missing: The precise, quantified magnitude of the growth requirement (reverse-DCF market-ceiling test); that the moat is confirmed eroding, not merely absent (ROIC falling every year for 3 straight years); and the specific overlap between the unresolved securities-fraud litigation and the exact autonomy claims (Autopilot/FSD/Robotaxi) the valuation premium depends on, compounded by a governance entrenchment sequence that narrows the tool that could hold the CEO accountable on those same claims.
edge_proof: If the motion to dismiss in the federal securities-fraud class action is denied and the case proceeds to discovery within 12 months, watch for TSLA's NTM EV/Sales multiple to compress from ~11.15x toward the peer/SOTP-implied range (~1.0-1.4x) over the following two to three quarters -- confirming the litigation overhang is doing real work against the optionality premium. If the motion is granted and the suit is dismissed with prejudice, or if Tesla discloses standalone, monetized robotaxi/FSD segment revenue with a credible profitability path, this thesis is falsified and the short should be closed.
killer_risk: An uncapped, momentum-driven repricing higher (short squeeze), especially if expressed as naked short stock rather than defined-risk options -- the fundamentals-derived bull case ($336.08) is NOT the true tail-risk ceiling; Tesla's own 5-year trading-multiple range implies levels up to $417.40.
kill_criteria: Disclosed robotaxi/Optimus/FSD segment revenue with a credible profitability path, closing the gap between the ~1.4x segment-level multiple SOTP implies and the ~11x consolidated multiple the market pays (valuation)
Return on capital rises sustainably above the ~12.4% cost of capital, reversing the confirmed 3-year eroding moat trajectory (business-model)
Federal securities-fraud class action dismissed with prejudice, removing the litigation overhang under the autonomy narrative's credibility (management-governance)
China Working Capital Facility successfully refinanced with a signed agreement well ahead of Sep-2026 (balance-sheet-survival)
Two consecutive quarters of EBIT margin stabilizing/improving without a one-off, plus revision breadth turning net-positive on profit lines (earnings)
